scope: All 108 names: the text was compared name by name with the page images of the TTD book (pp. 42–46), and every meaning was read against its name. There are no word-by-word glosses on this page (the meanings are per name). The range-number flags are the block labels. One ending (name 92, -tatparāyai or -tatpadāyai) could not be made out at the scan's resolution.

items.issue: Name 83 read -parimukhya-; the print has -parīmukhya-. Name 87 read dhātryacyuta-, which would mean “the earth and Acyuta”; the print has dhātracyuta- (dhātṛ + acyuta, Brahmā and Viṣṇu), which is what the meaning says.
Name 6, śaśāṅkaśekharaprāṇavallabhāyai, was “beloved of the moon-crested one's life”.
items.change: Now “dear as life to the moon-crested Lord”.

items.issue: Name 36, anaṅgajanakāpāṅgavīkṣaṇāyai, was “whose glance is that of the father of Anaṅga”; it is her sidelong glance that begets Love.
items.change: Now “whose sidelong glance gives birth to Anaṅga (Love)”.

items.issue: Name 43: devarṣi is “divine seer”, not “gods and seers”. Name 49: “a swan in rut” for mattahaṃsavadhū.
items.change: Now “praised by the divine seers” and “whose slow gait is that of a swan drunk with love”.

items.issue: Name 61, duṣṭabhītimahābhītibhañjanāyai, was “breaker of the great fear of the wicked”, dropping one member.
items.change: Now “breaker of the fear of the wicked and of every great fear”.

items.issue: Names 35 and 96: the print reads bhūtāliṅgana- (a syllable short; other lists bhūteśāliṅgana-) and vidheyamukta- (other lists videhamukti-). The meaning of 35 silently followed the other lists.
items.change: Both meanings now say what the other lists read; the text stays the print's, and SOURCES lists both.

items.issue: Names 73 (śrīlocanakṛtollāsaphaladāyai) and 83 (bhaktahaṃsaparīmukhyaviyogāyai) are marked “tentative” on the page; I could not improve on either with confidence.
options: B. Supply the meanings from a commentary or teacher you trust.
items.recommend: A, unless you have a traditional gloss to hand.
